## 📖 User Story
> **As a** [user/student/role] 
> **I want to** [action] 
> **So that** [benefit/value] 

*(Example: As a user in the study room, I want to set a 40-minute forward timer so that I can freely manage my focus time.)*

---

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
*Please list the specific criteria for this feature to be considered "done". Developers should check these off during implementation.*
- [ ] UI matches the Figma/design mockup expectations.
- [ ] Core interaction logic (e.g., button clicks, form submissions) works correctly without errors.
- [ ] (Please add specific business logic...)
- [ ] (Please add specific edge cases...)

## 💻 Technical Notes (Optional)
*(If you have specific requirements for the implementation, provide hints for the team here, e.g., which database collections to involve or existing React components to reuse)*
* **Frontend (React)**: 
* **Backend (Node/Express)**: 
* **Database (MongoDB)**:

## 🚦 Definition of Done (Must check before submitting PR)
*Before submitting a Pull Request, the developer must ensure all the following items are completed:*
- [ ] Code runs successfully locally without causing any page crashes.
- [ ] There are no Warnings or Errors in the Console.
- [ ] **Strict prohibition of `any` type in TypeScript code (all interfaces and types are explicitly defined).**
- [ ] All debugging `console.log()` statements have been removed.
